2609.37539.title: SkillGym: Training Skill-Use Agents with Automatic Verifiable Environment Generation
2609.37539.paper_summary: Skills equip LLM agents with professional knowledge and guidance to complete long-horizon and complex tasks. Although skills have been widely adopted in recent agent paradigms and harnesses, how to synthesize reliable training data and how to train agents for skill use remain underexplored. In this work, we propose SkillGym, an automatic pipeline to build verifiable environments, collect trajectories, and train skill-use agents. SkillGym first crawls a large volume of skills from the internet, then keeps those whose workflows can run reproducibly offline. A builder-reviewer pipeline is used to construct difficulty-controlled tasks, spanning four task types, each with a reference solution and an executable verifier. With this pipeline, we build 6.8k environments and collect 19k verified successful trajectories for supervised finetuning. Finetuning on these trajectories improves LLMs of different families and sizes, from 2B to 122B parameters across four skill-use benchmarks; Our Qwen3.5-9B SFT model outperforms the 397B untrained model on two of them. Further analysis shows that training teaches agents to invoke skills, raising the rate of reading the relevant skill from 28% to 96%, and that the gains hold across reasoning structures, extending to task types that form a minority of the training data and to skills held out from training
2609.37539.paper_summary_zh: 技能使 LLM 代理具備專業知識和指導，以完成長期和複雜的任務。儘管技能在最近的代理範式和應用中得到了廣泛採用，但如何合成可靠的訓練數據以及如何訓練代理使用技能仍然未被充分探索。在這項工作中，我們提出了 SkillGym，一個自動化管道，用於構建可驗證的環境、收集軌跡以及訓練技能使用代理。SkillGym 首先從互聯網上爬取大量技能，然後保留那些可以在離線環境中可重複運行的工作流程。使用建構者-審查者管道來構建控制難度的任務，涵蓋四種任務類型，每種都有參考解決方案和可執行的驗證器。通過這個管道，我們構建了 6.8k 環境並收集了 19k 經過驗證的成功軌跡以進行有監督的微調。在這些軌跡上進行微調改善了不同家族和大小的 LLM，從 2B 到 122B 參數，涵蓋四個技能使用基準；我們的 Qwen3.5-9B SFT 模型在其中兩個基準上超越了 397B 的未訓練模型。進一步的分析顯示，訓練使代理學會調用技能，將相關技能的閱讀率從 28% 提高到 96%，而且這些增益在推理結構中持續存在，延伸到訓練數據中佔少數的任務類型以及未參與訓練的技能。
